scope: Three public SpiderRock dictionaries inspected with the web tool. No SEC requests, source dataset acquisition, feature/return rows, evaluation or complete labels were read or built.

observations: close identifies the session closing price; closePr identifies the corporate-action-adjusted preceding close; closeUnadjPr identifies the unadjusted preceding close.
totalReturn denotes a daily total return; cumulReturnFactor accumulates a return factor from inception. The dictionary does not establish a split-only interpretation.
The documented US combined-history delivery schedule is 05:00 CT on T+1. It states no column-level differences from V7.
